Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Sloane Mid-Century Angled Leg Modern Ottoman, 31.9"W, Pebble
Colors: Pebble
Materials: Hardwood Frame With Solid Beech Wood Legs
Impress your friends with this mid-century modern style. The clean lines and silhouette of this ottoman will look smart in your living room or anywhere else a fashionable footstool is needed. Hardwood frame with solid beech wood legs Mid-century modern A great piece for putting up your feet, or as an extra seat for guests Simple assembly; just attach four legs Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty. 31.9”W x 24"D x 18.5"H
